changed.statement:

  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℕ =>
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let a := 3*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F W) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let next := fun i : Fin n =>
    (⟨(i.val+1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let h := fun (i : Fin n) (b : Fin 4) =>

  let supp := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ∃ x ∈ U, x i ≠ 0)

    |2*(L+1)*((a-host U : ℕ) : ℝ)/(n : ℝ)-1| ≤ ε)

changed.title: Three contraction ranks decide the two-extra-gate AND/OR budget after arbitrary independent cubic padding
changed.statement:
∀ (n m k : ℕ),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let legal := fun (n : ℕ) (C : Circ) =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack n C ∧
      (∀ h ∈ C.gates, h.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
        (h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or ∨ h.op = .mod 2 ∨ (h.op = .not ∧ h.inputs.length = 1)))
  let cost := fun (C : Circ) => C.gates.countP (fun h => @decide
    ((h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or) ∧ h.inputs.length = 2) (Classical.propDecidable _))
  let bits := fun (n : ℕ) (u : Fin n → F) => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin n => decide (u j = 1))
  let V := Fin n → F
  let diff := fun (g : V → F) (a x : V) => g (x+a) - g x
  let third := fun (g : V → F) (a b c : V) => diff (diff (diff g a) b) c 0
  let cubic := fun (g : V → F) => ∀ a b c d x, diff (diff (diff (diff g a) b) c) d x = 0
  let unit := fun (i j : Fin n) => if i = j then (1 : F) else 0
  let rankAt := fun (g : V → F) (u : V) =>
    (Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin n => third g u (unit i) (unit j))).rank
  ∀ (g : V → F) (R : Submodule F V), cubic g →
    (∀ u : V, u ∈ R ↔ ∀ v w : V, third g u v w = 0) →
    let d := n - Module.finrank F R
    ∀ e : (Fin n ⊕ (Fin m × Fin 3)) ≃ Fin k,
      let target := fun (y : Fin k → F) =>
        g (fun i => y (e (Sum.inl i))) + ∑ j : Fin m,
          y (e (Sum.inr (j,0))) * y (e (Sum.inr (j,1))) * y (e (Sum.inr (j,2)))
      (∃ C : Circ, legal (2*k) C ∧ cost C ≤ k+m+2 ∧ ∀ x y : Fin k → F,
        C.eval (bits k x ++ bits k y) = decide (dotProduct x y + target y = 1)) ↔
        d ≤ 5 ∨ (d = 6 ∧ ∃ u v : V,
          rankAt g u = 2 ∧ rankAt g v = 2 ∧ rankAt g (u+v) = 4)
changed.unlocks: Tests a fixed gate allowance using derivatives of the original cubic after any number of independent triples are appended.
changed.context: Fresh triples add 3m essential directions. At core dimension six the budget saturates the dimension bound. The rank-two span test descends to the core since ranks add on direct sums. Two rank-two contractions whose sum has rank four have disjoint support planes and annihilate each other’s directions. On their four remaining coordinates every cubic term contains one whole plane and can be absorbed into one of the two triples. In dimension five dualize a three-form to a bivector of rank at most four. A larger core cannot exist at this budget by the dimension bound.

changed.title: Recognizing a one-hot table's nonlinear gate budget by adaptive parities or a fixed batch with adversarial answer errors
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
    xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
        (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (Q : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (Q.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun h => ds.getD h 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD Q.output 0
∀ (a b t d e : ℕ),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let M := Matrix (Fin (a+1)) (Fin (b+1)) F
  let W := Fin d → F
  let r := 2*t
  let fits := fun (A : M) => ∃ Q : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    (∀ g ∈ Q.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (a+1+(b+1)) Q ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun x y => decide (A x y ≠ 0)) Q ∧
    depth (a+1+(b+1)) Q ≤ 1 ∧ Q.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ t
  let past := fun (z : W) (i : Fin d) (j : Fin i.val) => z ⟨j.val, Nat.lt_trans j.isLt i.isLt⟩
  let adaptive := ∃ (ask : (i : Fin d) → (Fin i.val → F) → M →ₗ[F] F) (out : W → Bool),
    ∀ (A : M) (z : W), (∀ i, ask i (past z i) A = z i) → (out z = true ↔ fits A)
  let batch := ∃ (ask : M →ₗ[F] W) (out : W → Bool), ∀ (A : M) (z : W),
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => z j ≠ (ask A) j)).card ≤ e → (out z = true ↔ fits A)
  let code := ∃ C : (Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) F) →ₗ[F] W, ∀ X, X ≠ 0 →
    2*e+1 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => C X j ≠ 0)).card
  (adaptive ↔ min a b ≤ r ∨ a*b - Nat.choose (r+1) 2 ≤ d) ∧
    (batch ↔ min a b ≤ r ∨ code)

changed.title: Reusable circuits for completing pinned words under two matched Hamming intervals
changed.statement:
∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ,
  let w := 1 + Nat.clog 2 (n+1)
  let V := Bool × Fin n
  let X := V → Bool
  let Digits := Fin w → Bool
  let value := fun (d : Digits) => ∑ i : Fin w, (d i).toNat * 2^i.val
  let raw := fun x : X => List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => x (false,i)) ++
    List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => x (true,i))
  let valid := fun (inputs budget : ℕ) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs g ∧ g.size ≤ budget ∧
    ∀ gate ∈ g.gates, ((gate.op = .and ∨ gate.op = .or) ∧ gate.inputs.length = 2) ∨
      (gate.op = .not ∧ gate.inputs.length = 1)
  ∃ (query : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (flag : Fin (2+12*w+query.size))
    (result : Bool → Fin w → Fin (2+12*w+query.size)),
    valid (2+12*w) (C*w) query ∧
    ∀ M : Bool → Equiv.Perm (Fin n),
      ∃ (prep build : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
        (summary : Fin (8*w) → Fin (2+4*n+prep.size))
        (output : V → Fin (2+4*n+2*w+build.size)),
        valid (2+4*n) (C*(n+1)*w) prep ∧
        valid (2+4*n+2*w) (C*(n+1)*w) build ∧
        ∀ (pin bit : X) (loR hiR loB hiB : Digits),
          let inputs := [false,true] ++ raw pin ++ raw bit
          let z := prep.wires inputs
          let qs := query.wires ([false,true] ++ List.ofFn (fun i => z.getD (summary i).val false) ++
            List.ofFn loR ++ List.ofFn hiR ++ List.ofFn loB ++ List.ofFn hiB)
          let read := fun (j : Bool) (i : Fin w) => qs.getD (result j i).val false
          let ws := build.wires (inputs ++ List.ofFn (read false) ++ List.ofFn (read true))
          let witness := fun v : V => ws.getD (output v).val false
          let count := fun (x : X) (j : Bool) => (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n =>
            x (false,i) ≠ x (true,M j i))).card
          let ok := fun x : X => (∀ v, pin v = true → x v = bit v) ∧
            value loR ≤ count x false ∧ count x false ≤ value hiR ∧
            value loB ≤ count x true ∧ count x true ≤ value hiB
          (qs.getD flag.val false = true ↔ ∃ x : X, ok x) ∧
          (qs.getD flag.val false = true →
            ok witness ∧ count witness false = value (read false) ∧
            count witness true = value (read true) ∧
            ∀ x : X, ok x → count witness false < count x false ∨
              (count witness false = count x false ∧ count witness true ≤ count x true))

changed.title: The exact parity leaf budget for disjoint products on a coset with up to two binary checks
changed.statement:
∀ (m e L : Nat),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let Q := Fin 2 → F
  let I := Fin m
  let X := I → Fin 2 → F
  ∀ (c : I → Fin 2 → Q) (base : X),
    let H := List Bool
    let D := X →ₗ[F] F
    let run := fun (T : Finset H) (ask : H → D) (bias : H → F) (x : X) =>
      (List.range T.card).foldl (fun (p : H) _ =>
        if p ∈ T then p ++ [decide (ask p x + bias p ≠ 0)] else p) []
    let syndrome := fun (x : X) (j : Fin 2) => ∑ i : I, ∑ u : Fin 2, (c i u j) * x i u
    let labels := (Finset.univ : Finset I).biUnion (fun i => ({c i 0, c i 1} : Finset Q))
    let h := Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F (↑labels : Set Q))
    let fullPair := ∃ i, c i 0 ≠ 0 ∧ c i 1 ≠ 0 ∧ c i 0 ≠ c i 1
    let r := m-e
    let p := if h = 0 then r else if h = 1 ∨ fullPair then r-1
      else (r-2) + (if r = 2 ∧ (labels.erase 0).card = 3 then 1 else 0)
    (∃ (T : Finset H) (ask : H → D) (bias : H → F) (P : H → I → D) (d : H → I → F),
      T.card < L ∧ ∀ x : X, syndrome x = syndrome base →
        let path := run T ask bias x
        ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun i => x i 0 * x i 1 ≠ P path i x+d path i)).card ≤ e) ↔
      2^p ≤ L

changed.title: A supplied adaptive pair probe tree admits polynomial certification and optimal circuit fits at each transposition size
changed.statement:
let header := fun z : Nat => List.replicate z true ++ [false]
let pairs := fun n : Nat => (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun i =>
  ((List.finRange n).filter (fun j => decide (i < j))).map (fun j => (i,j)))
let fast := fun g : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) g,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)
∃ solve : List Bool → List Bool, fast solve ∧
∀ (k : Nat) (crown : Bool), 2 ≤ k → (crown = true → 7 ≤ k) →
  let nr := if crown then k+2 else k
  let nc := if crown then k+1 else k
  let A := fun (i : Fin nr) (j : Fin nc) => if crown then
    decide (i.val ≠ k+1 ∧ ¬ (i.val < k ∧ i.val = j.val)) else decide (i.val = j.val)
  let Fn := (Fin nr → Bool) → (Fin nc → Bool) → Bool
  let eligible := fun f : Fn => ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    (if crown then PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 2*k+1 else PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*k) ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents A C ∧ ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)
  ∀ (hard : List ((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)))
    (soft : List (((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)) × Bool)),
  let fits := fun f : Fn => eligible f ∧ ∀ h ∈ hard, f h.1 h.2 = crown
  let score := fun f : Fn => (soft.filter (fun t => decide (f t.1.1 t.1.2 = t.2))).length
  let probe := fun f : Fn => (pairs k).toFinset.filter (fun e =>
    f (fun i => decide (i.val = e.1.val ∨ i.val = e.2.val)) (fun _ => false) = !crown)
  let vs := (pairs k).toFinset
  ∀ tree : List (List Bool × (Fin k × Fin k)),
  let keys := tree.map Prod.fst
  keys.Nodup → (∀ a e, (a,e) ∈ tree → e ∈ vs) →
  (∀ a bit, a ++ [bit] ∈ keys → a ∈ keys) →
  let atNode := fun (a : List Bool) => (tree.find? (fun r => decide (r.1 = a))).map Prod.snd
  let route := fun f : Fn => (List.range tree.length).foldl (fun a _ =>
    (atNode a).elim a (fun e => a ++ [decide (e ∈ probe f)])) ([] : List Bool)
  let good := ∀ a : List Bool, ∃ (b : Int) (w : Fin k × Fin k → Int), ∀ f : Fn,
    fits f → route f = a → (score f : Int) = b + (probe f).sum w
  let mask := fun S : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) => (pairs k).map (fun e => decide (e ∈ S))
  let banks := fun z : (Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool) => List.ofFn z.1 ++ List.ofFn z.2
  let x := [crown] ++ header k ++ header hard.length ++ hard.flatMap banks ++
    header soft.length ++ soft.flatMap (fun t => banks t.1 ++ [t.2]) ++ header tree.length ++
    tree.flatMap (fun t => header t.1.length ++ t.1 ++ header t.2.1.val ++ header t.2.2.val)
  let bits := fun z : Nat => (List.range (soft.length.log2+1)).map (fun j => z.testBit j)
  (good → ∃ slot : Fin (k/2+1) → List Bool,
    solve x = [true] ++ (List.finRange (k/2+1)).flatMap slot ∧
    ∀ s, let present := ∃ f : Fn, fits f ∧ (probe f).card = s.val
         (¬present → slot s = List.replicate (1+(pairs k).length+soft.length.log2+1) false) ∧
         (present → ∃ f : Fn, fits f ∧ (probe f).card = s.val ∧
           (∀ g : Fn, fits g → (probe g).card = s.val → score g ≤ score f) ∧
           slot s = [true] ++ mask (probe f) ++ bits (score f))) ∧
  (¬good → ∃ (a : List Bool) (P T : Finset (Fin k × Fin k)) (cube : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) → Fn),
    P = ((tree.filter (fun t => (t.1 ++ [true]).isPrefixOf a)).map Prod.snd).toFinset ∧
    Disjoint P T ∧ 2 ≤ T.card ∧
    (∀ U ⊆ T, fits (cube U) ∧ route (cube U) = a ∧ probe (cube U) = P ∪ U) ∧
    T.powerset.sum (fun U => (-1 : Int)^(T.card-U.card)*(score (cube U) : Int)) ≠ 0 ∧
    solve x = [false] ++ header a.length ++ a ++ mask P ++ mask T)

changed.statement:
∀ (p n r d : Nat) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (hd : 0 < d) (hn : d < n), 4 ≤ r →
